gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-chillax: Comic Relief draws every stroke the same thickness from side to side, with bowls left open on one side. Chillax follows in a loose, spaghetti-like line, and a slightly larger body size would help those unfinished loops.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-plein: Stout, pipe-cleaner strokes give Comic Relief its swagger up top.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-spline-sans: Comic Relief takes the top with bold, commanding strokes that look the same going up or sideways. Spline Sans below stays approachable, with wide gaps where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-synonym: Bold and commanding, Comic Relief shouts in strokes that look the same going up or across. Synonym then settles in as a plain sans, a constant stripe of ink with generous openings.
gen-gf-comic-relief-outfit: Comic Relief leads with bowls left unfinished on one side and strokes that never swell or thin. Outfit gives the pair its best quality, curves that stop well before they close, like bent cable.
gen-gf-comic-relief-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is modern and precise.
gen-gf-comic-relief-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads neutral and geometric, with a ribbon of constant width forming each glyph. Make the heading tiny and Comic Relief loses its bold punch, whereas Space Grotesk handles large sizes comfortably.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-public-sans: Tektur brings expressive, outsized lowercase with pipe-cleaner strokes and generous openings on every curve. Public Sans follows in a hefty, trustworthy build, and a modest body size would still leave its broad counters clear.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-familjen-grotes: Funnel Display uses spaghetti-like strokes of constant width.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-general-sans: Glowing tube letters, splayed and bold, with a large x-height under short ascenders. General Sans fills its line with the same steady pressure, and a body size a notch above usual lets that show.
